title: Reply to a family email by voice
intro: We will open the inbox, pick the email from Mom, add a few words by voice, and press Send.

steps.say: This is a dashboard with made-up data. Nothing here is real, and nothing is sent. First, we open the inbox.
Your assistant lists the emails that need a reply. We pick the one from Mom.
A draft is already written for you. Read it, and edit it by typing if you like.
To add words by voice, turn on the microphone and talk.
Your spoken words are added to the draft.
When it looks right, press Send.
The demo says nothing was sent. In the real dashboard, nothing goes out until you press Send yourself.
That is the whole workflow. Press Replay to watch it again.
